data.description:
## Goal

Confirm on the live proxy that the restored liveness-based prefill lease
extension (LP-0MUXQ5QL40027VZ4) stops the kill/retry loop for long local
prefills.

## Context

Fix landed in commit 2ced52ac: `_extend_lease_during_prefill` now extends the
lease on numeric progress advance OR observed slot liveness
(`is_processing`), with the `local_dispatch_max_prefill_seconds` ceiling still
bounding a wedge. Before the fix, `lease_extended_during_prefill` was 0 and
every local prefill >180s was released and cancelled by the no-progress
watchdog, so clients retried into full re-prefills (see LP-0MUXQ5QL40027VZ4).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Over a post-deploy window, `lease_extended_during_prefill` events appear in
   `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log` with `progress=None alive=True` (the b8782
   liveness-only shape), where the pre-fix count was 0.
2. `lease_released ... reason=no_progress_watchdog` count drops sharply versus
   the same-length pre-fix window; `dispatch_first_byte_timeout` and
   `backend_retry ... ReadTimeout` counts drop.
3. Local prefills longer than `local_dispatch_no_progress_timeout_seconds`
   (180s) complete rather than being re-queued repeatedly.
4. A genuinely wedged slot (no progress, no liveness) is still released
   (watchdog reason still fires when appropriate).
5. If (1)-(4) do not hold, roll back commit 2ced52ac from `dev` and record the
   observed evidence.
data.title: Verify liveness-based prefill lease extension on a live post-deploy window

## Plan auto-complete

Planning Complete. This item is a single, small, self-contained live-verification
task with five measurable acceptance criteria. It is not an epic and has no natural
feature decomposition — splitting it would create artificial child items with no
independent value. It is sufficiently sized and defined for direct implementation /
verification, so planning auto-completes (Process step 1 heuristic: non-epic with
measurable ACs; err toward auto-complete).

Existing evidence already on this item: LP-C0MUXTW7JL0060XTE (fast mode PASS, cheap
mode FAIL at 2ced52ac) and LP-C0MUXYXZK500781XJ (cheap-mode heavy-load re-verification
PASS at 9b7c505c). The follow-up RCA/fix for the cheap-mode gap is LP-0MUXTW4MD003TVIC
(completed).

### Automated review stages on existing content

1. Requirements & AC alignment review — the goal (confirm the restored liveness-based
   prefill lease extension stops the kill/retry loop on the live proxy) is faithfully
   expressed by AC1–AC5. Each AC traces back to the goal: AC1 measures the new
   extension shape, AC2/AC3 measure the disappearance of the kill/retry loop, AC4 is
   the safety counter-case, AC5 is the rollback condition. No contradictory or invented
   ACs found.
2. Completeness review — description and a `## Acceptance criteria` section are present;
   no child items exist (correct for this scope). No `**Key Files:**` section is present;
   this is a live-log verification task rather than a code-change task, so a Key Files
   section is not required and none was added.
3. Sequencing & dependencies review — no children and no dependency edges, so ordering
   is vacuous; no test-before-implementation violation is possible.
4. Scope sizing review — the item is a single deliverable increment (deploy, observe a
   post-deploy window, compare against a pre-fix window, roll back on failure). No
   sizing action needed.
5. Acceptance & testability review — all five ACs are pass/fail and measurable:
   event/presence counts in `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log`, comparative count drops
   versus a same-length pre-fix window, completion of prefills exceeding
   `local_dispatch_no_progress_timeout_seconds`, watchdog firing for a genuinely wedged
   slot, and an explicit rollback condition.
6. Polish & handoff review — description is clear, well formatted, and actionable;
   context (commit 2ced52ac, pre-fix `lease_extended_during_prefill` = 0) is sufficient
   for an implementer to execute the verification.

### AC coverage review

`apply_coverage_review(<id>, target_stage="plan_complete")` returned `action=proceed`
(no children, so parent-AC coverage is vacuous / 100%). The item was advanced to
`plan_complete`.

### Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No clarifying questions were required. The description supplies an unambiguous goal and
five measurable acceptance criteria, and the existing comment trail records the live
verification evidence. No OPEN QUESTIONs remain.
